- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Players must guess the correct characters from a list of options in Hangman.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If a player guesses a correct character in Hangman, it is revealed in the correct position in the word.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If a player guesses incorrectly in Hangman, a part of a stick figure is drawn.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The game of Hangman is won by guessing the word before the stick figure is fully drawn, or lost if the stick figure is completed before the word is guessed.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Scrabble is played in Chinese similarly to English, with players placing tiles with Chinese characters on a game board.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The goal in Scrabble is to create words and earn points, with rules for scoring and word construction generally the same as in English Scrabble.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Word searches in Chinese work similarly to English, with words to be found in Chinese.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In a word search, players look for a list of words hidden in a grid of letters, with words running horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] When a word is found in a word search, it is crossed off the list.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The game of word search is won when all the words have been found.
